why: Issue #797's defect exactly: the meta stamping the SHIPPED arm instead of the one the recorder was given, which is what it did while it omitted the field entirely. Deliberately silent -- the trace still parses and the data fingerprint still reports a match, because it covers the four sim JSON files and the arm's values live in sim/config/pp1-roles.ts, outside it. `pp1Roles` is the first ReplayMeta field that is not a World.rules switch: it is a construction-time stamp that writes per-role shellCap/mineCap onto tanks, so a finished world cannot be asked which arm built it and no assertion about the world can catch this.
killedBy: the pp1Roles arm survives a round trip (issue #797) reads the arm from the recorder, because the world cannot be asked
the pp1Roles arm survives a round trip (issue #797) rebuilds the ARM caps from the meta alone, not the shipped ones
